integrity: The theorem is supported by an analytic deterministic EFX reduction and binomial normal/local-limit proof, plus a separately runnable finite checker. Finite computation is not treated as proof of infinite asymptotics. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal unit additive endpoint valuations on labeled-edge multistars, zero-inclusive EFX, independent fair orientation; fixed leaf count with each subsidiary multiplicity divergent and subsidiary total o(dominant multiplicity). No claims about arbitrary graphs, valuation heterogeneity, weaker EFX definitions or dependent allocations.
title: A square-root crossover in the probability of fair orientations of multistars
